snippet.title: A Long Survive ™ — Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Will you survive?

The briefing is simple, soldier. Hold the ground, build your defenses, and protect the nexus. Remember what they took from us. 🏴

A Long Survive is a cooperative survival shooter releasing in Autumn 2025. Wishlist now for Meta Quest and Steam!
